title: Traditional ANZAC Biscuits
description: A classic Australian favourite — golden, chewy, and steeped in history. Perfect with a cuppa and a quiet moment.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 150°C. Line 4 oven trays with baking paper.
Combine flour, oats, and sugar in a large bowl.
Gently melt butter, golden syrup, and water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Alternatively, melt in a microwave using 30-second bursts.
Stir in bi-carb soda, then remove from heat.
Add syrup mixture to dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Roll tablespoons of mixture into 35 g balls.
Place on trays 8 cm apart and flatten slightly.
Bake for 18–20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on trays before transferring to a tin. Use a wire rack to cool completely.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best enjoyed with a strong cup of tea and a good story. Store in an airtight tin — they keep beautifully.

notes.title: Portioning Guide
notes.content: Weight should be 35 g each ball of raw cookie dough. You can also use egg rings if making larger cookies up to 50 g.
